mapper.sql: id, request_id, report_type, period_start, period_end, status, content, error_message, zone_id, version, edited_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reports (id, request_id, report_type, period_start, period_end, status, content, zone_id, processing_token) VALUES (#{id}, #{requestId}, 'DAILY', #{date}, #{date}, 'PROCESSING', '', #{zoneId}, #{token}) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'RECORD' source_type, wr.id entity_id, CASE WHEN wr.completion_result <> '' THEN wr.content || E'\n完成结果：' || wr.completion_result ELSE wr.content END content, wr.project_id, p.name project_name, wr.source source_status, wr.occurred_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('source',wr.source,'taskId',wr.todo_id,'completionResult',wr.completion_result)::text snapshot FROM work_records wr LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=wr.project_id WHERE wr.occurred_at >=#{start} AND wr.occurred_at <#{end} AND wr.is_active ORDER BY wr.occurred_at, wr.id

SELECT gen_random_uuid() id, NULL::uuid report_id, 'TASK' source_type, t.id entity_id, CASE WHEN t.notes <> '' THEN t.title || E'\n备注：' || t.notes ELSE t.title END content, t.project_id, p.name project_name, t.status source_status, t.due_at source_time, jsonb_build_object('priority',t.priority,'notes',t.notes)::text snapshot FROM todo_items t LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id=t.project_id WHERE t.due_at >=#{start} AND t.due_at <#{end} AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status='PENDING' ORDER BY t.due_at, t.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO report_sources (id, report_id, source_type, entity_id, content, project_id, project_name, source_status, source_time, snapshot) VALUES (#{id}, #{reportId}, #{source.sourceType}, #{source.entityId}, #{source.content}, #{source.projectId}, #{source.projectName}, #{source.sourceStatus}, #{source.sourceTime}, CAST(#{source.snapshot} AS jsonb))
mapper.select: SELECT id, report_id, source_type, entity_id, content, project_id, project_name, source_status, source_time, snapshot::text snapshot FROM report_sources WHERE report_id=#{reportId} ORDER BY source_time, id
mapper.update: UPDATE reports SET status='SUCCEEDED', content=#{content}, error_message=NULL, processing_token=NULL, version=version+1, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND processing_token=#{token}
UPDATE reports SET status='FAILED', error_message=#{message}, processing_token=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PROCESSING' AND processing_token=#{token}
UPDATE reports SET content=#{content}, version=version+1, edited_at=#{now}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SUCCEEDED' AND version=#{version}
